name: What should homeowners in older Salt Lake City homes consider before converting a tub?

mainEntity.name: What should homeowners in older Salt Lake City homes consider before converting a tub?

acceptedAnswer.text: In older Salt Lake City neighborhoods such as Sugar House, The Avenues, or Harvard-Yale, vintage homes often feature original cast iron plumbing, galvanized supply lines, or uneven framing. Converting a tub in these homes frequently involves replacing corroded piping beneath the subfloor and updating old venting systems to comply with modern residential building codes before installing a modern waterproof shower assembly.
acceptedAnswer.description: Older Salt Lake homes often have outdated galvanized or cast iron plumbing and uneven framing that may require updating to meet modern codes before shower installation.
